candidates.reason: This test module directly imports and exercises the internal HTTP/2 protocol, factory, stream, and exception classes whose names are expected to become private, and it patches the protocol-name constant. It is the strongest candidate for detecting incomplete renames, stale imports, or stale mock paths.

This test module verifies the documented Twisted-based HTTP/2 handler's import path, DOWNLOAD_HANDLERS configuration, reactor requirements, lifecycle, and HTTP/2 behavior. It should confirm that privatization preserves the supported handler entry point and that the handler is no longer treated as experimental.
